title: test_verify_openssl_rsa_signed uses SystemTime::now() — time bomb 2036
description: smime_tests.rs test_verify_openssl_rsa_signed passes std::time::SystemTime::now() to verify(). The CA cert and RSA leaf cert in the fixtures expire 2036-04-29. CI will start failing on or after that date with no code change. The verify() API accepts an explicit 'now' parameter precisely to avoid this; tests must pass a fixed time that is within the cert validity window, not the real clock. Scenario: in 10 years, CI breaks silently without any code change.
